structural_source.notice:
# Character enrichment sources

These optional, unreviewed annotations were supplied in the character-enrichment
handoff. The original canonical catalogue remains separate and unchanged.

- Make Me a Hanzi dictionary, commit bddc96d41bef78427ed0e034e9f7e31d71fd1b92:
  LGPL-3.0-or-later. Corresponding dictionary source and licence notices are in
  `notices/`. Source: https://github.com/skishore/makemeahanzi/tree/bddc96d41bef78427ed0e034e9f7e31d71fd1b92
- Hanzi Writer Data 2.0.1: Arphic Public License. Geometry is fetched on demand
  from the version-pinned package, not replaced by standalone components.
  Notice: `notices/STROKE_DATA_ARPHICPL.txt`.
- BabelStone IDS, 2025-06-27 / Unicode 16.0: source comparisons retain their
  regional qualifiers. The supplied manifest records permission evidence, not
  an independently established licence for all underlying characters. No full
  BabelStone snapshot is redistributed here. Source: https://www.babelstone.co.uk/CJK/IDS.TXT
- GF 0014-2009: eight bounded textual rule-example annotations only. No PDF,
  font artwork, table artwork or complete standard component inventory is
  redistributed. Source: https://www.unicode.org/irg/docs/n2739-GF0014-2009.pdf

`manifest.json` retains the supplied source versions, hashes, consumer policy,
licence-notice references and coverage. Original generator/audit utilities and
all their inputs were not provided; the local split adapter is not a substitute
for rerunning that upstream audit. Exact source agreement and complete stroke
coverage do not establish editorial approval, etymology or verified stroke names.

entries.text: A depiction of a human with a prominent head → unified group of people (← one head representing many; compare the expression "per capita," along with the character 員). *Page* is a borrowed meaning.
頭也。从𦣻从几。古文䭫首如此。凡頁之屬皆从頁。𦣻者，䭫首字也。

translation.text: The head. Formed from 𦣻 and 几. The ancient graph for bowing the head has this form. All characters in this group follow 頁. 𦣻 is the graph for bowing the head.

entries.text: As per 丁# (straight) + 頁 head → place straight atop the head → *place atop* → *top/summit*; *prop up* → *receive*; *eat* (← bow and ceremoniously raise received goods above one's head).
顚也。从頁丁聲。

translation.text: The crown of the head. Formed from 頁, with 丁 indicating the sound.

entries.text: 頁 head + an abbreviated form# of 化 transformation → incline one's head, transforming one's posture → *for a moment/short time* (← incline the head briefly) → *lately/recently* (← short time ago); (vague period of) *time*.
頭不正也。从匕从頁。

translation.text: A head not upright. Formed from 匕 and 頁.

entries.text: As per 工# (connecting pipe/tube) + 頁 head → nape of the neck (connecting head and trunk) → *clause*; *item* (← figurative associations, from the idea of connecting points).
頭後也。从頁工聲。

translation.text: The back of the head. Formed from 頁, with 工 indicating the sound.

entries.text: 川# river + 頁 head (→ group of people) → people following a winding course traced by a river (compare 馴 and 沿) → *follow* → *sequence*; *order*.
理也。从頁从巛。

translation.text: Orderly or in accord. Formed from 頁 and 巛.

entries.text: A depiction of an old man with a long, soft *beard*. The present form is 彡 pattern (here suggesting beard whiskers) + 頁 head. *Necessary*, *should* and *ought* are borrowed meanings.
面毛也。从頁从彡。凡須之屬皆从須。

translation.text: Facial hair. Formed from 頁 and 彡. All characters in this group follow 須.

鬚.example: 胡须 → 鬍鬚; 必须 → 必須

須.example: 必须 → 必須; 胡须 → 鬍鬚

entries.text: 頭頊頊謹皃。从頁玉聲。

translation.text: The head showing a cautious manner, 頊頊. Formed from 頁, with 玉 indicating the sound.

entries.text: 公# public + 頁 head (→ group of people) → declaim to a public crowd → *recite*; *acclaim*; *praise*.
皃也。从頁公聲。

translation.text: Appearance. Formed from 頁, with 公 indicating the sound.

entries.text: 舉頭也。从頁支聲。《詩》曰：“有頍者弁。”

translation.text: To raise the head. Formed from 頁, with 支 indicating the sound. The Odes says: “The cap stands raised.”

entries.text: As per 亢# (stretch) + 頁 head → *bird alighting* (from directly overhead). (Human) *throat* is a borrowed meaning via 吭.
予# (stretch) + 頁 people → long line of reserve troops, or other personnel → *in advance* (← keep/prepare in advance) → *keep* → *deposit* → *entrust* (← entrust funds for safekeeping).
安也。案：經典通用豫。从頁，未詳。

translation.text: At ease. Note: the classics also use 豫. Formed from 頁; further details are unknown.

entries.text: As per 元# (rounded/oval head) + 頁 head → rounded/oval head → *stubborn* (← make no progress in convincing another ← circular discussion going round and round in a person's head; compare 願) → *stout*. 頑 was devised to convey the original sense of 元, but it too acquired extended meanings.
㮯頭也。从頁元聲。

translation.text: A solid, rounded head, 㮯頭; the precise description is uncertain. Formed from 頁, with 元 indicating the sound.

entries.text: 分# portion + 頁 people → apportion (goods/information) to a crowd → *divide*; *distribute*.
大頭也。从頁分聲。一曰鬢也。《詩》曰：“有頒其首。”

translation.text: A large head. Formed from 頁, with 分 indicating the sound. Another explanation: temple hair. The Odes says: “Large is its head.”

entries.text: As per 屯# (swollen) + 頁 (group of people) → camp swollen with soldiers (compare 軍 and 營) → *stop*; *settle* (down) (← form a camp) → *arrange*. *Prostrate oneself*, *bow deeply*, *suddenly*, *hastily* and *all at once* are borrowed meanings.
下首也。从頁屯聲。

translation.text: To lower the head. Formed from 頁, with 屯 indicating the sound.

entries.text: As per 皮# (align) + 頁 head → align one's head with one shoulder → *lean* → *bias* (← lean toward one party/point of view). Also, *to a great degree* (← lean/be biased to a considerable extent).
頭偏也。从頁皮聲。

translation.text: The head tilted to one side. Formed from 頁, with 皮 indicating the sound.

entries.text: As per 令# (long sequence) + 頁 head → string of heads severed at the *neck* (compare 県 and 梟) → *rule*; *possess* (← display severed heads to demonstrate rule) → *domain*.
項也。从頁令聲。

translation.text: The neck. Formed from 頁, with 令 indicating the sound.

entries.text: 頭不正也。从頁从耒。耒，頭傾也。讀又若《春秋》陳夏齧之齧。

translation.text: The head not upright. Formed from 頁 and 耒; 耒 depicts the head inclined. Also read like 齧 in the Spring and Autumn’s Xia Nie of Chen.

entries.text: 𩔞也。从頁合聲。

translation.text: The jaw, 𩔞. Formed from 頁, with 合 indicating the sound.

entries.text: As per 安# (rest in/on) + 頁 head → the *bridge of the nose* (← object that adheres to the front of the head as the ears adhere to the sides; compare 耳).
鼻莖也。从頁安聲。

translation.text: The bridge of the nose. Formed from 頁, with 安 indicating the sound.

entries.text: 顙也。从頁各聲。

translation.text: The forehead. Formed from 頁, with 各 indicating the sound.

entries.text: 頭閑習也。从頁危聲。

translation.text: The head composed and practiced in bearing. Formed from 頁, with 危 indicating the sound.

entries.text: As per 吉# (reduce/eliminate space) + 頁 head (→ group of people) → tight and large gathering → *take wing*; *fly up* (← tight and large flock of birds) → *snatch*; *rob* (← gather up and flee).
直項也。从頁吉聲。

translation.text: To straighten the neck. Formed from 頁, with 吉 indicating the sound.

entries.text: 短面也。从頁𠯑聲。

translation.text: A short face. Formed from 頁, with 𠯑 indicating the sound.

entries.text: 舉目視人皃。从頁臣聲。

translation.text: To raise the eyes and look at someone. Formed from 頁, with 臣 indicating the sound.

entries.text: As per 𦣝# as described in 煕 (jaw) + 頁 head (for emphasis/clarification) → *jaw*. Also, *raise the jaw*; *raise the jaw and thrust it in the direction of a person/object*. *Nourish* is by further extension (← raise in the manner of closing a child's jaws around food) → *raise/rear*.
醜也。从頁亥聲。

translation.text: Ugly. Formed from 頁, with 亥 indicating the sound.

entries.text: 頭妍也。从頁，翩省聲。讀若翩。

translation.text: A beautiful head. Formed from 頁, with abbreviated 翩 indicating the sound. Read like 翩.

entries.text: 難曉也。从頁、米。一曰鮮白皃。从粉省。

translation.text: Hard to understand. Formed from 頁 and 米. Another explanation: a fresh white appearance, using abbreviated 粉.

entries.text: As per 兆# (split) + 頁 head → *lower one's eyes* (← break off eye contact) → *hang one's head*.
低頭也。从頁，逃省。太史卜書，頫仰字如此。楊雄曰：人面頫。

translation.text: To lower the head. Formed from 頁 and abbreviated 逃. The Grand Historian’s divination writings use this form for 頫 in “looking down and up.” Yang Xiong says: “A person’s face looks downward.”

entries.text: 豆# bean + 頁 head → bean-shaped *head* → *head* (of a group); *leader*; *top*. Also, *hair* (on the head), *beginning* (compare 元), *brains*, *intellect* and *the mind*, as well as *counter for certain animals* (compare English "head of cattle").
首也。从頁豆聲。

translation.text: The head. Formed from 頁, with 豆 indicating the sound.

entries.text: 權也。从頁𢌳聲。

translation.text: The cheekbones. Formed from 頁, with 𢌳 indicating the sound.

entries.text: As per 夾# (pressed between) + 頁 head → the jaw (← part of the head that enables food and other objects to be pressed between the upper and lower rows of teeth). *Cheeks* is via a different perspective on sandwiching with regard to the head (i.e., cheeks between which food in the mouth is pressed).
面㫄也。从頁夾聲。

translation.text: The sides of the face. Formed from 頁, with 夾 indicating the sound.

entries.text: As per 廷# (extend) + 頁 head → elongated head → *straight*.
狹頭頲也。从頁廷聲。

translation.text: A narrow head. Formed from 頁, with 廷 indicating the sound.

entries.text: 頭頵頵大也。从頁君聲。

translation.text: The head large, 頵頵. Formed from 頁, with 君 indicating the sound.

entries.text: As per 含# (contain in the mouth) + 頁 head → the jaw (which closes to contain food in the oral cavity) → *chin* (that enables containment in the mouth). *Nod* (the head) is by association with the up and down movement made by the jaw in chewing.
面黃也。从頁含聲。

translation.text: A yellow face. Formed from 頁, with 含 indicating the sound.

entries.text: As per 巠# as described in 徑 (extensive) + 頁 head → (long) *neck* extending between the head and torso → *throat*; *head*.
頭莖也。从頁坙聲。

translation.text: The stalk supporting the head. Formed from 頁, with 坙 indicating the sound.

entries.text: 歩# walk + 頁 people → people marching in close formation, with no interval between them → *occur repeatedly* (← various persons marching over a given spot).
禿# bald head + 頁 head (for emphasis/clarification) → hair loss → *decline*; *decay*; *sink*; *collapse* (← decline in powers often attending loss of hair).
口上須也。从須此聲。

translation.text: Hair above the mouth. Formed from 須, with 此 indicating the sound.

entries.text: 出頟也。从頁隹聲。

translation.text: A protruding forehead. Formed from 頁, with 隹 indicating the sound.

entries.text: 頭鬢少髮也。从頁肩聲。《周禮》：“數目顅脰。”

translation.text: Little hair on the head and temples. Formed from 頁, with 肩 indicating the sound. The Rites of Zhou says: “Many eyes and a 顅 neck”; the quoted phrase is uncertain.

entries.text: 果# fruit + 頁 head → (fruit-shaped or head-shaped) *clod* (compare 塊 as well as 圣 as described in 怪); *small round object* → *counter for small round objects*.
小頭也。从頁果聲。

translation.text: A small head. Formed from 頁, with 果 indicating the sound.

entries.text: As per 卒# (compact) + 頁 head → drawn visage → *haggard*.
顦顇也。从頁卒聲。

translation.text: Haggard, 顦顇. Formed from 頁, with 卒 indicating the sound.

entries.text: 低頭也。从頁金聲。《春秋傳》曰：“迎于門，顉之而巳。”

translation.text: To lower the head. Formed from 頁, with 金 indicating the sound. The Spring and Autumn Commentary says: “He welcomed him at the gate and merely nodded.”

entries.text: As per 思# (fine) + 頁 head → *jaw*; *lower jaw* (← finely chisled, lower part of the face). *Gills* is a borrowed meaning via 鰓.
As per 是# (straight) + 頁 head → forehead that thrusts straight out (compare 額) → end; edge → *subject*; *title*; *topic*; *theme* (← subject that presents itself ← forehead that protrudes).
頟也。从頁是聲。

translation.text: The forehead. Formed from 頁, with 是 indicating the sound.

entries.text: 客# guest/customer + 頁 head (→ group of people) → *notice board* to attract guests/customers → *amount* (← fee displayed on a notice board). *Forehead* is a borrowed meaning, via a character combining 頁 and 各 rather than 客.
As per 咢# (cross, especially, cross over, or back and forth) + 頁 head → *jaw* (enabling the crossing back and forth of the upper and lower teeth in chewing; compare 鰐). For "jaw," compare 頤 and 齶.

As per 彦# (handsome/well-formed) + 頁 head → *face*; *forehead*; *countenance*; *appearance* → *influence* (← face/person that carries weight). 顏 was devised to replace 彦 after 彦 acquired its associated meanings. Compare the form 顔.
飯不飽，面黃起行也。从頁咸聲。讀若戇。

translation.text: Not getting enough food, with a yellow face and lines appearing; the wording 起行 is uncertain. Formed from 頁, with 咸 indicating the sound. Read like 戇.

entries.text: 大頭也。从頁禺聲。《詩》曰：“其大有顒。”

translation.text: A large head. Formed from 頁, with 禺 indicating the sound. The Odes says: “Its size is grand.”

entries.text: As per 耑# (neatly aligned) + 頁 head → well-proportioned head/face → *respectful* (← head/face meriting respect). *Exclusive(ly)* is a borrowed meaning, via 專.
頭顓顓謹皃。从頁耑聲。

translation.text: The head showing a cautious manner, 顓顓. Formed from 頁, with 耑 indicating the sound.

entries.text: As per 彦# (handsome/well-formed) + 頁 head → *face*; *forehead*; *countenance*; *appearance* → *influence* (← face/person that carries weight). 顔 was devised to replace 彦 after 彦 acquired its associated meanings. Compare the form 顏.
眉目之閒也。从頁彥聲。

translation.text: The area between the eyebrows and eyes. Formed from 頁, with 彥 indicating the sound.

entries.text: Variant form of 悤# as described in 窓 (compression) + 頁 head → *fontanel*, (open spaces in an infant's skull, eventually covered when bone is compressed/fuses over them). Compare 兒 and 思.
謹莊皃。从頁豈聲。

translation.text: A cautious, dignified appearance. Formed from 頁, with 豈 indicating the sound.

entries.text: As per 原# (round) + 頁 head → round head. Eventually, 願 came to be associated with the idea of a notion that circulates persistently in the brain (compare 惱 and 慮), leading to the extended meanings *wish*; *desire*; *hope* → *request*; *petition*; *application*.
大頭也。从頁原聲。

translation.text: A large head. Formed from 頁, with 原 indicating the sound.

願.explanation: 願 is the normal traditional form for wishing, desiring or being willing; 愿 may survive as a distinct literary character meaning honest/cautious.
願.usageCaveat: The 2013 table lists 願 as the traditional counterpart; uncommon inherited use of 愿 should not be automatically converted.
願.evidenceScope: Targeted review of individual relationships against 2013 通用规范汉字表 Appendix 1; not a comprehensive audit of every Unihan pair.

entries.text: 頟也。从頁桑聲。

translation.text: The forehead. Formed from 頁, with 桑 indicating the sound.

entries.text: As per 眞# (fullness) + 頁 head → head held fully upright → *top (of the head)* → *peak*; *summit* → *topple/fall*; *tip*; *overturn* (← topple on account of being top-heavy) → *beginning* (← tip). Note a variant form, 顛.
頂也。从頁眞聲。

translation.text: The crown of the head. Formed from 頁, with 眞 indicating the sound.

entries.text: 大頭也。从頁骨聲。讀若魁。

translation.text: A large head. Formed from 頁, with 骨 indicating the sound. Read like 魁.

entries.text: 犬 dog/beast (→ animals in general) + an element# combining 米 rice (→ plants in general) and 頁 (people) → sort a variety of things according to type, creating smaller piles → *variety*; *kind* → *broadly*.
種類相似，唯犬爲甚。从犬頪聲。

translation.text: Members of a kind resemble each other, especially dogs. Formed from 犬, with 頪 indicating the sound.

entries.text: 高長頭。从頁堯聲。

translation.text: A high, long head. Formed from 頁, with 堯 indicating the sound.

entries.text: As per 景# (expansive) + 頁 head → expansive, shiny pate → *whitish brightness*.
白皃。从頁从景。《楚詞》曰：“天白顥顥。”南山四顥，白首人也。

translation.text: A white appearance. Formed from 頁 and 景. The Songs of Chu says: “Heaven is white and bright.” The four Hao of the Southern Mountain were white-headed men.

entries.text: As per 焦# (shrink) + 頁 head → *emaciated* visage → *haggard*; *worn-out*.
顦顇也。从頁焦聲。

translation.text: Haggard, 顦顇. Formed from 頁, with 焦 indicating the sound.

entries.text: As per 雇# (caged bird) + 頁 head → caged bird looking about nervously (compare 瞿) → *look back* → *consider*; *review*; *reflect on*; *take note of*; *pay attention to*.
還視也。从頁雇聲。

translation.text: To turn and look back. Formed from 頁, with 雇 indicating the sound.

entries.text: 巽也。从丌从𩔊 。此《易》顨卦“爲長女，爲風”者。

translation.text: The same as 巽. From 丌 and 𩔊. This is the Changes' Xun hexagram: “the eldest daughter” and “wind.”

entries.text: 𪙊皃。从頁僉聲。

translation.text: An appearance described as 𪙊, perhaps a gaping or uneven mouth; the gloss is uncertain. Formed from 頁, with 僉 indicating the sound.

entries.text: 亶 here an abbreviated form# of 邅 (faltering movement) + 頁 head → faltering motion represented by *nodding* of the head → *tremble*; *shake*. Compare 震.
頭不正也。从頁亶聲。

translation.text: The head not upright. Formed from 頁, with 亶 indicating the sound.

entries.text: As per 需# (soft) + 頁 head → the *temple* (← soft portion of the head). Compare 顳.

㬎# combines 日 here an abbreviated form of 旱 dry up + 絲 thread(s) → silk threads exposed for drying in the sun. 顯 adds 頁 head → expose and make *manifest* a person's head (specifically, a severed head; compare 縣 as described in 県) → *visible*; *clear* → *noticeable*; *remarkable*. Despite appearances, 㬎 has no etymological connection with 濕 or 隰.
頭明飾也。从頁㬎聲。

translation.text: Bright ornament on the head. Formed from 頁, with 㬎 indicating the sound.

entries.text: As per 頻# (no interval) + 卑 low → *knitted brows*, the ends bordering the top of the nose (nearly) fusing → *frown*; *scowl*. Compare 嚬.
涉水顰蹙。从頻卑聲。

translation.text: To frown and shrink back while crossing water. Formed from 頻, with 卑 indicating the sound.

entries.text: As per 盧# (sunken) + 頁 head → (sunken) *head*; *skull*.
𩑒顱，首骨也。从頁盧聲。

translation.text: 𩑒顱, the bones of the head. Formed from 頁, with 盧 indicating the sound.

entries.text: 面䫲顲皃。从頁𤎭聲。

translation.text: The face gaunt or discolored, 䫲顲; the precise expression is uncertain. Formed from 頁, with 𤎭 indicating the sound.

entries.text: As per 聶# (press together) + 頁 head → the *temple* (between the aligned pair of which the skull is pressed). Compare 顬.
As per 雚# as described in 勸 (circular uniformity) + 頁 head → the *cheekbone(s)*. Compare 馗.

entries.text: A variant form of 鳳 (large bird flapping its wings), later conceived of as the source of *wind* causing various life forms and other objects to flutter → *trend*; *atmosphere*; *taste*; *custom* (← things brought in then carried off by the wind).
八風也。東方曰明庶風，東南曰清明風，南方曰景風，西南曰涼風，西方曰閶闔風，西北曰不周風，北方曰廣莫風，東北曰融風。風動蟲生。故蟲八日而化。从虫凡聲。凡風之屬皆从風。

translation.text: The eight winds: east, 明庶; southeast, 清明; south, 景; southwest, 涼; west, 閶闔; northwest, 不周; north, 廣莫; northeast, 融. Wind moves and creatures are born; hence creatures transform in eight days. Formed from 虫, with 凡 indicating the sound. All characters in this group are formed from 風.

entries.text: 風 wind + 下 down → (cold) *wind that blows down from the mountains*.
As per 占# (fixed in place) + 風 wind → object fixed in place but which sways in a breeze → *sway* (in a breeze).
風吹浪動也。从風占聲。

translation.text: Wind blowing and waves moving. Formed from 風, with 占 indicating the sound.

entries.text: 風 wind + 立, here an abbreviated form# of 竦 for the sound alone to simulate rushing wind → the *sound of the wind*. Also, *bleak* (← wind-blasted) → *weaken*; *decline*.
翔風也。从風立聲。

translation.text: A soaring wind. Formed from 風, with 立 indicating the sound.

entries.text: As per 台# (heavy downward pressure) + 風 wind → *typhoon* (originally, simply a strong wind, and not necessarily identical with the modern meteorologic definition of "typhoon").

entries.text: 烈風也。从風𠛱聲。讀若𠛱。

translation.text: A fierce wind. Formed from 風, with 𠛱 indicating the sound. Read like 𠛱.

entries.text: 風 wind + 具# to supply the sound note in giving written expression to a dialectal term referring to a *typhoon* (originating in the South China Sea).
涼風也。从風思聲。

translation.text: A cool breeze. Formed from 風, with 思 indicating the sound.

entries.text: 昜# rise + 風 wind → object that rises in the wind → *rise*; *fly (high)* → *raise one's voice*.
風所飛揚也。从風昜聲。

translation.text: What the wind lifts and sends flying. Formed from 風, with 昜 indicating the sound.

entries.text: As per 䍃# as described in 搖 (waver) + 風 wind → *waver in the wind*.
馬疾步也。从馬風聲。

translation.text: A horse’s rapid steps. Formed from 馬, with 風 indicating the sound.

entries.text: 高風也。从風翏聲。

translation.text: A high wind. Formed from 風, with 翏 indicating the sound.

entries.text: As per 票# (light) + 風 wind → *whirlwind* (strong enough to raise even heavy objects) → *flutter*; *float*.
回風也。从風㶾聲。

translation.text: A revolving wind. Formed from 風, with 㶾 indicating the sound.

entries.text: As per 猋# (circle about) + 風 wind → *whirlwind*.
扶搖風也。从風猋聲。

translation.text: A rising whirlwind. Formed from 風, with 猋 indicating the sound.

entries.text: A depiction of the curved wings of a bird spread right and left in flight (compare 非) → *fly* → *speedy*.
鳥翥也。象形。凡飛之屬皆从飛。

translation.text: A bird soaring. A pictograph. All characters in this group are formed from 飛.

entries.text: The relevant oracle bone form of this character combines the top element as described in 今 (cover) + a depiction of heaped grain → grain in a covered pile in a storehouse → *eat*; *feed*; *drink*; *consume* → *make a living*. Also, *strike/absorb a blow*, *scold/be scolded*, *defeat/be defeated* and *lose* (territory/market share etc.) (← figuratively eat or be eaten into). (Insect) *bite* is a borrowed meaning via 蝕.
一米也。从皀亼聲。或說亼皀也。凡食之屬皆从食。

translation.text: A portion of rice. From 皀; 亼 supplies the sound. Another account: 亼 and 皀 combined. All graphs in this category contain 食.

entries.text: Effectively a variant form of 饑, combining 几# (tall → tall and lean) + 食 food/eating → long, lean appearance of one suffering from a lack of food (same as for 餓) → *hunger* (for); *starve*.
餓也。从食几聲。

translation.text: Hunger. From 食; 几 supplies the sound.

飢.explanation: The hunger expression is normally written 飢餓 in the pinned OpenCC phrase dictionary; 饑餓 is also attested in Taiwan MOE lexicographic examples. 饑 is especially associated with famine and scarcity contexts.
飢.example: 饥饿 → 飢餓 (OpenCC 1.4.2); 饑餓 (also attested in Taiwan MOE)
飢.evidenceScope: All examples in this note were individually reviewed against cited pinned OpenCC phrase records or identified supplementary sources. This does not establish unconditional character conversion, all regional spelling choices or full mainland-2013 certification.
飢.usageCaveat: Both spellings are documented, but do not imply that both are outputs of the same OpenCC phrase record or that they have an exclusive Taiwan-versus-Hong-Kong split.

supplementarySources.finding: Documents famine and hunger senses, explicitly illustrating 饑荒 and 饑餓.
Headword 飢餓 means being very hungry.

attestedTargets.qualification: Both forms are attested, including within Taiwan MOE sources. The checked OpenCC phrase row records 飢餓 only; no exclusive region split is established.

qualification.recommendation: Both 飢餓 and 饑餓 are attested. Separate the two dictionary attestations from the OpenCC phrase policy, which records 飢餓; do not describe the slash as two OpenCC outputs or an exclusive Taiwan/Hong Kong rule.

entries.text: As per 丁# (straight) + 食 food/eating → *tall pile of dried fruit or other food*.
糧也。从人、食。

translation.text: Provisions. From 人 and 食.

entries.text: An abbreviated form of 餐 meal, simplifying the element at top to 夕 evening → *evening meal*.
As per 屯# (swollen) + 食 food/eating → meat/vegetable-filled *dumpling* → thick *noodles* (← noodle portion of soup ← noodle soup containing dumplings).
As per 壬# (encompass) + 食 food/eating → a filling encompassed by a lump of *boiled food* → *cook*/*boil* a long time.
大孰也。从食壬聲。

translation.text: Thoroughly cooked. From 食; 壬 supplies the sound.

entries.text: A variant form of 餘 (surplus food), with 夭# replacing 余. The idea of surplus food leads in 飫 to the meaning *be/become satiated*. Also, *drinking party* and *banquet*.
致堅也。从人从力，食聲。讀若敕。

translation.text: To make firm. Formed from 人 and 力, with 食 indicating the sound. Read like 敕.

entries.text: 反# bend back + 食 food/eating → fold cooked rice back upon itself with a spatula → (cooked) *rice*; *food*; *meal* → *feed* (a person); *eat* (rice).
食也。从食反聲。

translation.text: To eat. From 食; 反 supplies the sound.

entries.text: The relevant bronzeware inscription form is as per 酓# (contain alcohol) + 欠 (cavity) → pour (a drink/medicine) into the mouth → *drink*; *swallow*; *take* (medicine) → *smoke* (tobacco) (← consume with the mouth). Eventually, 酓 was replaced by 食 food/eating. Note a variant form 飮.
As per 台# (heavy downward pressure) + 食 food/eating → knead foodstuffs (in making sweets) → *candy*.
米糱煎也。从食台聲。

translation.text: Rice malt boiled down. From 食; 台 supplies the sound.

entries.text: 楚人相謁食麥曰飵。从食乍聲。

translation.text: People of Chu call visiting one another to eat wheat 飵. From 食; 乍 supplies the sound.

entries.text: 必 here an abbreviated form# of 苾 aroma + 食 food/eating → *aroma* of food.
食之香也。从食必聲。《詩》曰：“有飶其香。”

translation.text: The fragrance of food. From 食; 必 supplies the sound. The Odes says: “Fragrant is its aroma.”

entries.text: 貪也。从食，殄省聲。《春秋傳》曰：“謂之饕飻。”

translation.text: Greedy. From 食; abbreviated 殄 supplies the sound. The Spring and Autumn commentary says: “Called 饕飻.”

entries.text: 司# administer + 食 food/eating → administer (= distribute) feed in raising animals → *keep* (a pet); *raise* (animals).
包# envelop + 食 food/eating → plenteous food enveloped in the stomach → *become tired/weary of* (eating) → *be satiated*; *be fed up with*; *become bored with*. Also, *do to a great degree*.
猒也。从食包聲。

translation.text: Satiated. From 食; 包 supplies the sound.

entries.text: The element# combining 食 food/eating + 𠂉 a variant of 人 person means "feed" (v.). 飾 adds 巾 cloth (→ cloth ornament) → *ornament* a room for a feast → *decoration*; *adornment* → *display*; *be ostentatious*; *appear*.
㕞也。从巾从人，食聲。讀若式。一曰襐飾。

translation.text: To brush. Formed from 巾 and 人, with 食 indicating the sound. Read like 式. Another explanation: adornment.
